ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the central and outer-middle regions, and 35% low-intensity black pixels localized at the trailing edge, median notch, and lateral tips.
